_doc: The /diag check list. web/build.py validates it, expands each file list (with the byte sizes it wrote) and publishes it as dist/diag_checks.json; diag.js probes every entry live from the browser. The only external service is the jsDelivr CDN that serves onnxruntime-web to the policy viewer.

checks.name: page
checks.label: Showcase page
checks.purpose: The home page, its stylesheet and icon are served

checks.name: viewer
checks.label: Policy viewer
checks.purpose: The viewer page and its scripts are served

checks.name: status-page
checks.label: Status page
checks.purpose: This page and its probe script are served

checks.name: version
checks.label: Build version
checks.purpose: version.json carries the same stamp and commit as this page (no stale or mixed deploy)

checks.name: screenshots
checks.label: Screenshots
checks.purpose: Every screenshot on the home page is served and decodes

checks.name: policies
checks.label: Brains and recordings
checks.purpose: Every ONNX brain the viewer runs and its recorded race are served

checks.name: privacy
checks.label: Privacy policy
checks.purpose: The Android app's privacy policy page is served

checks.name: inference
checks.label: Policy inference (onnxruntime-web)
checks.purpose: onnxruntime-web loads from cdn.jsdelivr.net and a brain run here reproduces its recorded action
